description: A sixteen channel mixer fed from a single polyphonic cable, offering both a polyphonic mix with the faders applied and a monophonic sum

params.text: Sets the level of that channel, 0% to 100%; every one of the sixteen comes up at 0%, so nothing reaches the outputs until they are raised
Attenuates the whole mix, 0% to 100%; it comes up at 100%
Silences that channel; pressing it also takes the channel out of solo
Solos that channel, so only soloed channels reach the outputs; pressing it also unmutes the channel
Silences the polyphonic and monophonic outputs together, and the Alembic expander's channel outputs with them

inputs.text: The polyphonic cable feeding the sixteen mixer channels; cable channel 1 goes to mixer channel 1 and so on, and its channel count sets how many of the sixteen are in use
Shifts the master level; the voltage is divided by 5 and added to the MASTER knob, with the total held between 0% and 200%, so +5V doubles the mix
Engages the master mute while the voltage stands at 1V or more

outputs.text: The sum of the mixed channels as a single monophonic signal, saturated rather than clipped once it passes ±10V
The mix as a polyphonic cable, one channel per input channel, each after its own fader and the master level

notes: Every channel fader comes up at 0%, so a freshly placed Alchemist is silent until they are raised.
Bypassing the module copies the polyphonic input straight to the polyphonic output.
The lights at the top left and top right show a Crucible expander on the left and an Alembic expander on the right; both can be connected at once.
menu: Add Crucible expander — puts a Crucible expander immediately to the left of this module and connects it; the entry reads "Crucible expander already connected" when one is already there
Add Alembic expander — puts an Alembic expander immediately to the right of this module and connects it; the entry reads "Alembic expander already connected" when one is already there

inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 2V.
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
